date: "2026-11-20"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
```

# Data Import

```{r data_import}
rodent_df =
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ahx2-5kkr/query.csv") |>
  content("parsed")
```

# Initial Data Inspection

```{r data_inspection}
str(rodent_df)

skimr::skim(rodent_df)
```

# Data Cleaning

```{r}
rodent_df =
  rodent_df |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(
    created_date,
    descriptor,
    incident_zip,
    borough,
    latitude,
    longitude
  )
```

# Checking Variables

```{r}
skimr::skim(rodent_df)

rodent_df |>
  group_by(borough) |>
  summarize(n = n())

rodent_df |>
  group_by(descriptor) |>
  summarize(n = n())
```

```{r}
rodent_df =
  rodent_df |>
  mutate(
    borough = str_to_title(borough),
    month = lubridate::floor_date(created_date, unit = "month")
  )
```

# Final data check

```{r}
skimr::skim(rodent_df)

rodent_df |>
  group_by(borough) |>
  summarize(n = n())

rodent_df |>
  group_by(descriptor) |>
  summarize(n = n())

rodent_df |>
  summarize(
    first_month = min(month),
    last_month = max(month)
  )
```
